data.exact_reserve_text: Included within net claims incurred is adverse prior year development relating to certain financial lines classes; reduced by positive developments across a number of other classes.

named_events.loss_description: The Syndicate continues to have no incurred claims from COVID-19 and has suffered no major disruption to its operations.

named_events.event_name: FCA Property Business Interruption Test Case
named_events.loss_description: UK Supreme Court judgment of 15 January 2021 regarding the FCA Property Business Interruption Test Case was found largely in favour of policyholders and has been implemented by QBE.
Uncertainty remained in relation to the ultimate impact on claims liabilities in respect of a challenge to the deductibility of furlough payments which has been raised in the Stonegate litigation.
An initial assessment concluded limited or no underwriting exposure within the Syndicate to Ukraine and neighbouring countries; impact on financial assets not expected to be material at this stage.

data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2021 the Syndicate reported gross claims outstanding of GBP 1,269.6m (opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2021: GBP 1,251.8m). The report does not quantify a single gross prior-year development amount; it states that net claims incurred included adverse prior year development in certain financial lines offset by favourable development in other classes, resulting in a mixed prior year picture. No explicit gross prior-year movement figure is presented in the notes; the claims development tables and narrative indicate both adverse and favourable developments across cohorts.
